title: extension.contract@1
description: What a manifest declares about the contract it was built against (#139), beside extension.manifest@1, whose frozen shape doesn't list it: whether the package declares itself stable, the preview entries it uses by name, and the JSON-RPC methods it calls. A package that never says is preview, so it can't call a preview entry without listing it, and a package that lists one can't declare itself stable.

stability.description: stable: the package calls stable entries only. A package that doesn't say is preview.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

items.description: A preview entry the package uses, by name: an extension API method or a kind.
A JSON-RPC method the package calls on the hub; one deprecated is named at install and by deep doctor.
